resources.string:
"%1$s" at %2$s (port %3$d).

Check that the computer's pairing window shows the code %4$s.

Continue only if you started pairing on that computer.
Could not reach %1$s at %2$s. The phone and the computer must be on the same network (or both on Tailscale), and the computer\'s firewall must allow PhoneBox.
%1$s did not accept the code: it works once and for 5 minutes. Start pairing again on the computer.
The computer has a different certificate than the QR code. Start pairing again.
Turns the phone screen off when the PC locks. PhoneBox reads nothing on the screen.
The panel can\'t run on this phone: Android could not start its WebView. Some Android 5 phones can\'t run the WebView versions PhoneBox needs.
Share the clipboard with the Mac

Text you copy on the Mac appears on this phone. To send text to the Mac, select it and tap \"Send to Mac\", use Share › Send to Mac, or the Send to Mac tile in Quick Settings. The Mac\'s own Phone bridge switch (in PhoneBox settings on the computer) must be on too.
The Mac\'s clipboard switch is off (Settings › Phone bridge on the computer)
The Mac\'s clipboard switch is off
Nothing to send: the clipboard is empty or private
Too long to send (the limit is 64 KiB)
Calls, messages and app notifications appear on the Mac with their text. Choose individual apps or turn on All apps. Turn on phone notifications in the Mac’s Phone bridge settings too.
Notification access is not allowed yet. PhoneBox needs it to see your notifications.
Notification access is allowed, but Android has not started the listener yet. Open this screen again, or check PhoneBox\'s battery setting.
If the switch is greyed out (Android 13 and later): open App info, tap ⋮ at the top right, choose Allow restricted settings, then come back and try again.
Last notification: the Mac\'s notification switch is off
Last notification could not reach the Mac; it is kept for two minutes
This computer can\'t share the clipboard: the phone bridge needs the PhoneBox agent on a Mac
Stopped by Android. Open this screen again, or restart PhoneBox, to reconnect
Send this text to the Mac\'s clipboard?
More text follows that is not shown (characters: %1$s, lines: %2$s).
The Mac no longer knows this phone: connect it by USB once, or pair again.
No answer from the Mac: the text may have arrived. Check on the Mac before sending it again.
